test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech. He said, "May God bless you."

options.text: He told that God should bless me.
He said that God may bless me.
He prayed that God might bless me.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He prayed that God might bless me.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"May God bless you" becomes "that God might bless me"**
 
 
• The verb "may" is changed to "might" in indirect speech.
 
• The personal pronoun "you" is changed to "me" according to the context.
 
 
 
• **Reporting Verb:** "said" is changed to "prayed" to reflect the context of a blessing or wish.
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is converted into a subordinate clause using "that".
 
• The verb tense is adjusted to match the rules of indirect speech.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *He prayed that God might bless me.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He told that God should bless me."

 
 
• The reporting verb "told" is incorrect in this context as it does not convey a wish or prayer.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "He said that God may bless me."
 
 
• The modal verb "may" remains unchanged, which is incorrect in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "He wished God bless me."
 
 
• The sentence is grammatically incorrect as it omits the conjunction "that" and does not follow proper structure.
